column1: # Stage S11 J0a — xtask's shared core folder empties: the deploy settings reader becomes the
# deploy_settings crate, the test locks and the test checkout root become tool_test_support, the
# PATH guard joins process_runner, the repository locations join repository_layout, and the cargo
# target directory checks join the ci command group; the CLI-shaped tests join the CLI.
# Paths name the tree before the moves. Partial moves (one file split over several homes) move the
# file to its main home here and are cut by hand.
# the deploy settings reader becomes the deploy_settings crate
# the PATH guard is process mechanics and joins process_runner; its environment lock is cut into
# the working-directory lock and the test checkout root become tool_test_support
# xtask's repository locations join repository_layout; the deployment, tool input and reference
# lane locations are cut into their own files by hand, the workspace-law locations stay with the
# the cargo target directory checks join the ci command group; the build output folder names and
# their tests are cut into repository_layout, the shared pin into its own ci module, by hand
